description: Is this file one Fileion has scanned? Takes the SHA-256 (or SHA-1 / MD5) of a download. If found: the title, version, file, "N of 5 checks passed", the official source host and the Fileion page address. Not found means Fileion has no record of the file; it is not a warning.

hash.description: The file's SHA-256 (64 hex characters), SHA-1 (40) or MD5 (32).

name: lookup_file_hash
title: Look up a file hash
